market_summary: Weekend, markets shut since Friday's close: S&P -0.4%, Nasdaq -0.9% Friday, both up 2%+ on the week. Chips were the weak spot, with NVDA down about 12% on the week. The 10-year touched 5.17% and the last FedWatch reading had a December hike near 77%. Next week is busy: Warsh speaks Mon, then Nvidia earnings, US retail sales and RBA minutes Tue, FOMC minutes Wed, Alibaba Thu, and GDP plus PCE Nov 25.
